title: Uzbekistan Tourism Project Overview
content: Nuxt 4 tourism website featuring an interactive 3D map of Uzbekistan with scroll-driven transitions. Built with Three.js for 3D rendering, Vue 3 for reactivity, and TWEEN.js for animations.

title: Technology Stack
content: Framework: Nuxt 4 (Vue 3.5) | 3D: Three.js 0.182 | Animations: TWEEN.js 25, Anime.js 4 | TypeScript enabled | CSS: Vanilla CSS with custom properties | Build: Vite

title: Directory Structure
content: app/ - Main application | app/components/ - Vue components (HeroSection, AboutSection, CloudOverlay) | app/composables/ - Composables (useMap/, useScrollTransition) | app/pages/ - Page routes (index.vue) | app/assets/ - Static assets and fonts | public/ - Public files and SVGs

title: Nuxt Configuration
content: Compatibility version 4 | Main CSS at ~/assets/css/main.css | HTML lang=en | Vite server with allowedHosts enabled | Devtools disabled
